Index vector data as you normally would. The GPU-acceleration automatically applies to indexing
and force-merge operations. The following example demonstrates how to add vector documents
to your index using the bulk API. Each document contains a vector ﬁeld with numerical values and
associated text content:
POST _bulk
{"index": {"_index": "my-vector-index"}}
{"vector_field": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, ...], "text": "Sample document 1"}
{"index": {"_index": "my-vector-index"}}
{"vector_field": [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, ...], "text": "Sample document 2"}
Force-merge operations
GPU-acceleration also applies to force-merge operations, which can signiﬁcantly reduce the
time required to optimize vector indexes. Note that force-merge operations aren't supported
on collections. The following example demonstrates how to optimize your vector index by
consolidating all segments into a single segment:
POST my-vector-index/_forcemerge?max_num_segments=1
